title: SuperTrend
author: KivancOzbilgic
publish_or_update_date: Mar 13, 2020 (page shows "Updated Apr 6, 2020" badge; release notes also mention Feb 16, 2021)
capture_method: Browser DOM capture: clicked the script page's "Source code" tab, then joined the rendered code viewer's per-line <span> elements' textContent with \n (U+00A0 normalised to U+0020, no page-text/accessibility-tree extraction). Transferred to disk byte-exact via a URL-fragment handoff to a localhost sink and verified with an end-to-end FNV-1a checksum against the in-page value. Cross-checked byte-identical (SHA-256) against an independent capture taken via TradingView's own "Copy to clipboard" control.
